art.scope: Nine original-size current map PNGs; no continuous-motion or performance review, no full geometry certification.
findings: Near dark fragmented grass was substantially reduced; revised low grasses fit the soil and neighbouring vegetation better.
Earth tint reduces conspicuous pale rubble discs. No obvious floating scan skirt in the reviewed views.
North and south house views show no obvious trunk-through-wall or roof intersection; visible roads and structural hierarchy did not regress.
Minor: some yellow-green leaves still read as sparse lines and isolated clumps. Prioritize low-plant transitions, not additional instance counts.
Minor: a few micro-rubble pieces still have similar rounded flat outlines. Locally obscure/bury edges while preserving traversability.

fiveAxes.sameness: isolated clumps and rounded fragments remain repetitive
fiveAxes.stylization: material coherence improved; overall realism target not reached
fiveAxes.visualImpact: new detail no longer draws excessive contrast
